assert sha(parent.read_bytes())=="7baa3fd7d23b092729b1967a26aff29dac2150d454748340692ff19da55cf7dd"
for v in proposal["existing_source_inputs"].values():assert sha((root/v["path"]).read_bytes())==v["sha256"]
out=root/"reports/research/510300_bank_demand_native_calendar_same_quarter_history_v1";out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
def save(name,x):
 p=out/name
 if p.exists():raise RuntimeError("已登记产物存在，禁止重复："+rel(p))
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
 return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}
